declaration.preface: At Alchem International Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to ensuring that all employees receive fair, equitable, and sustainable compensation. We believe that every individual deserves a wage that meets their basic needs and supports a decent standard of living for themselves and their families. This Living Wage Policy reflects Alchem’s dedication to upholding human dignity, promoting social equity, and aligning with international labour and human rights standards. Through this initiative, Alchem seeks to enhance employee well-being, strengthen financial security, and contribute to the overall economic resilience of the communities in which we operate.
declaration.declaration:
Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all employees and contract workers receive a living wage — the minimum income required to meet essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation while maintaining a dignified standard of living. Our commitment goes beyond compliance, reflecting our dedication to fairness, equality, and social responsibility.

Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to continually improving its wage practices to ensure that all employees, contract workers, suppliers, and contractors receive fair and equitable compensation. The Living Wage Policy will be implemented in phases across business units, targeting full adoption by FY 2027–28. The policy will be regularly updated to reflect changes in local living costs, inflation, and market conditions. Alchem aims to set a benchmark for fair wages in the pharmaceutical and herbal ingredients industry, ensuring that every worker is treated with dignity, respect, and equity.
declaration.scope: This policy is applicable across all Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. facilities, offices, research centers, and manufacturing units, as well as all employees, workers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and business partners. It also extends to the communities in which we operate, ensuring that our commitment to environmental responsibility and sustainability is embedded across our global value chain. By including our suppliers and other stakeholders, we seek to promote sustainable practices beyond our own operations and drive positive environmental and social impact throughout the industry.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all employees and contract workers receive a living wage — the minimum income required to meet essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation while maintaining a dignified standard of living.

We ensure that all wages adequately cover essential living costs, including food, housing, healthcare, transportation, and education. Alchem periodically assesses local economic conditions to ensure pay levels reflect the actual cost of living in each location.

Alchem regularly reviews and updates its wage framework to account for inflation, cost-of-living changes, and market trends. Periodic wage assessments are conducted across all business units to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay for all employees and contract workers globally.

Alchem is dedicated to paying wages that exceed the statutory minimum wage in every region where we operate. We ensure that compensation enables employees to sustain a decent quality of life, promoting financial stability and overall well-being.

Sets FY 2022-23 as the Baseline for tracking our living wage compliance and employee compensation performance.

The review will evaluate progress toward defined targets, assess the policy’s effectiveness, and ensure alignment with evolving legal requirements and industry best practices in labour rights.

Ltd. is committed to ensuring that all employees and contract workers receive a living wage — the minimum income required to meet essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation while maintaining a dignified standard of living. Our commitment goes beyond compliance, reflecting our dedication to fairness, equality, and social responsibility.

We ensure that all wages adequately cover essential living costs, including food, housing, healthcare, transportation, and education. Alchem periodically assesses local economic conditions to ensure pay levels reflect the actual cost of living in each location.

Alchem upholds the principle of equal pay for equal work, ensuring that compensation is free from discrimination based on gender, age, ethnicity, or any other personal characteristic. We are committed to gender pay equity and transparent, merit-based wage structures.

Alchem regularly reviews and updates its wage framework to account for inflation, cost-of-living changes, and market trends. Periodic wage assessments are conducted across all business units to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay for all employees and contract workers globally.
Action Framework: Annual Wage Reviews: Alchem International will conduct yearly wage assessments to ensure that all employees and contract workers receive pay aligned with local living costs, inflation, and economic conditions.
Pay Audits: Regular pay equity audits will be carried out to eliminate any wage disparities based on gender, role, or other factors, with corrective actions implemented promptly.

Supplier Code of Conduct: All suppliers and contractors must adhere to Alchem’s Supplier Code of Conduct, which mandates fair compensation and living wage compliance; non-compliance will trigger corrective measures or contract review.

Employee Feedback: Alchem will maintain open communication channels for employees to report wage-related concerns, ensuring transparency, timely resolution, and reinforcement of equitable pay practices.
Communication and Transparency: Alchem International’s Living Wage Policy will be publicly accessible on the company website and communicated internally to all employees and contract workers through handbooks, newsletters, and training sessions.

Alchem will actively engage with suppliers and contractors to ensure they understand living wage requirements and provide guidance, including training on wage equity and human rights, to support full compliance.
Continuous Improvement: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd. is committed to continually improving its wage practices to ensure that all employees, contract workers, suppliers, and contractors receive fair and equitable compensation. The Living Wage Policy will be implemented in phases across business units, targeting full adoption by FY 2027–28. The policy will be regularly updated to reflect changes in local living costs, inflation, and market conditions. Alchem aims to set a benchmark for fair wages in the pharmaceutical and herbal ingredients industry, ensuring that every worker is treated with dignity, respect, and equity.

responsibilities.duty: Responsible for implementing Alchem’s Living Wage Policy, conducting regular wage reviews, and ensuring compliance with wage equity standards for all employees and contract workers across business units and regions.
Conducts audits of suppliers and contractors to verify adherence to Alchem’s living wage and fair labour practices, documents findings, and recommends corrective actions where necessary.
Ensure that employees and contract workers under their supervision are compensated fairly in accordance with the policy and address wage-related concerns promptly and transparently.
Required to comply with Alchem’s living wage standards, provide accurate wage data for their workforce, and undergo annual audits to ensure adherence to fair compensation practices.

policy.monitoring:
Annual Living Wage Report: Alchem International will publish a yearly report detailing progress toward living wage objectives for employees and contract workers, including results from wage reviews, pay equity audits, and supplier compliance assessments.

Employee Feedback and Surveys: Periodic employee surveys will be conducted to assess satisfaction with wages and benefits, with insights used to guide wage reviews and continuous policy improvement.

Supplier Audits: The compliance team will carry out annual audits of high-priority suppliers and contractors to ensure payment of living wages, with non-compliance addressed through corrective actions or potential contract termination.
policy.reviewMechanism: Alchem International Pvt. Ltd.’s Living Wage Policy will be reviewed annually by the Human Resources Department in collaboration with the Compliance Team. The review will evaluate progress toward defined targets, assess the policy’s effectiveness, and ensure alignment with evolving legal requirements and industry best practices in labour rights. Any updates or adjustments will be communicated to all employees, contract workers, suppliers, and business partners.
